dossier.scope: Joseph at the banquet, resistance, prayer and imprisonment
dossier.chronology: Genesis belongs to earlier Jewish textual tradition, but date of composition must be distinguished from extant Hebrew, Greek and Syriac witnesses; no specific dates authenticated in this pass.
dossier.comparison: Qur'an 12:31 adds a banquet, women cutting their hands, and astonishment at Joseph; no matching scene in Genesis 39. Qur'an 12:32-34 narrates the woman's admission, threat, Joseph's prayer and divine answer; Genesis 39:7-12 recounts his refusal grounded in loyalty and sin against God. Qur'an 12:35 says imprisonment follows signs; Genesis 39:19-20 places it after the master's anger at the wife's accusation. Narrative similarity is not proof of copying.
